episodes.title: Don't Say His Name
episodes.description: One name made a whole village go silent. He was on his way to meet the man behind it.

scenes.narration: The whole inn fell silent the moment he said one name: Dracula.
scenes.visual: Frightened villagers crowding around a young traveller in a candlelit mountain inn

scenes.narration: Jonathan Harker, a young English lawyer, had crossed Europe to meet this Count.
scenes.visual: Jonathan stepping off a coach in a misty Carpathian village square at dusk

scenes.narration: The Count was buying a house in London, and Jonathan carried the deeds.
scenes.visual: A wax-sealed letter with a dark crest lying on a map of London

scenes.narration: An old woman begged him to turn back, and pushed a crucifix into his hand.
scenes.visual: An old peasant woman pressing a small silver crucifix into Jonathan's palm

scenes.narration: Tonight, she whispered, evil walks the earth.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of an old woman's frightened eyes lit by firelight

scenes.narration: At midnight, a black carriage came for him.
scenes.visual: A black four-horse carriage waiting on a snowy mountain pass under a full moon

scenes.narration: The driver's grip was like iron. And his eyes glowed red.
scenes.visual: A tall cloaked coachman holding the reins, face in shadow, eyes glowing red

scenes.narration: Then the wolves came, dozens of them, circling the carriage.
scenes.visual: A pack of wolves with glowing eyes among dark pine trees in moonlight

scenes.narration: The driver raised one hand, and every wolf went silent.
scenes.visual: The coachman raising a pale hand as wolves cower in a ring around the carriage

scenes.narration: So who was driving? In Part 2, Jonathan finds out, and wishes he hadn't.
scenes.visual: The carriage disappearing up a winding road toward a huge dark castle on a cliff

episodes.title: The Man With No Reflection
episodes.description: Jonathan's host never eats, never sleeps by night, and never appears in a mirror.

scenes.narration: Jonathan's host casts no reflection, and Jonathan is about to see it for himself.
scenes.visual: A vast ruined castle on a cliff edge under a full moon, a carriage at its gate

scenes.narration: Count Dracula greets him at the door: tall, pale, dressed all in black.
scenes.visual: A tall old nobleman holding an antique oil lamp in an arched stone doorway

scenes.narration: His hand is ice cold. And impossibly strong.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a pale clawlike hand gripping a younger man's hand

scenes.narration: He never eats. Jonathan never sees him in daylight.
scenes.visual: Jonathan dining alone at a long candlelit table while the Count watches from the shadows

scenes.narration: One morning, shaving at a little mirror, Jonathan feels a hand on his shoulder.
scenes.visual: Jonathan shaving at a small mirror beside a window in pale morning light

scenes.narration: The Count is standing right behind him. The mirror shows no one.
scenes.visual: A small hand mirror reflecting only Jonathan and an empty room behind him

scenes.narration: The razor slips. A drop of blood runs down his chin.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a thin trickle of blood on a young man's chin, razor in hand

scenes.narration: The Count's eyes blaze, and he lunges for Jonathan's throat.
scenes.visual: The Count lunging forward with blazing red eyes and clawed hands

scenes.narration: His hand touches the crucifix, and he jerks back like it burned him.
scenes.visual: The Count recoiling from a small glowing crucifix on Jonathan's chest

scenes.narration: That night, Jonathan tries every door. All locked. In Part 3, he learns he isn't the only guest.
scenes.visual: Jonathan pulling at a heavy iron-bound locked door in a dark stone corridor

episodes.title: The Women in the Moonlight
episodes.description: Jonathan falls asleep in the wrong room, and wakes up to three women and their teeth.

scenes.narration: Three women lean over Jonathan as he sleeps, and their teeth are sharp.
scenes.visual: Three pale women in flowing white gowns leaning over a sleeping man in moonlight

scenes.narration: Hours earlier, he saw something impossible from his window.
scenes.visual: Jonathan peering from a high castle window at night

scenes.narration: The Count, crawling head first down the castle wall, like a lizard.
scenes.visual: The Count crawling face-down down a sheer stone wall, cloak spread like bat wings

scenes.narration: Desperate to escape, Jonathan searched the castle and found a forbidden wing.
scenes.visual: Jonathan entering a dusty moonlit room full of old furniture

scenes.narration: He fell asleep there. And woke up to them.
scenes.visual: Jonathan asleep on an old couch in a shaft of moonlight

scenes.narration: One bends so close he can feel her breath on his throat.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a pale woman with sharp gleaming teeth leaning down

scenes.narration: Then the door bursts open.
scenes.visual: A heavy door slamming open, a tall shadow filling the doorway

scenes.narration: The Count hurls her across the room, eyes blazing. This man belongs to me, he snarls.
scenes.visual: The Count furious, eyes blazing, flinging the women away from the couch

scenes.narration: But he isn't saving Jonathan. He's saving him for later.
scenes.visual: Close-up of the Count's cold smile in the dark, eyes burning red

scenes.narration: In Part 4, Jonathan finds out where the Count sleeps.
scenes.visual: The three women smiling hungrily in the dark as Jonathan lies frozen in fear

episodes.title: Where the Count Sleeps
episodes.description: Jonathan finds the Count's resting place, and the fifty boxes bound for London.

scenes.narration: Jonathan opens the box, and finds the Count inside, his lips wet with blood.
scenes.visual: The Count lying in a box of earth in a crypt, eyes open, blood on his lips

scenes.narration: To get here, he climbed barefoot down the castle wall.
scenes.visual: Jonathan climbing barefoot down the outside of the castle wall above a deep gorge

scenes.narration: Down into a ruined chapel full of wooden boxes.
scenes.visual: A ruined chapel crypt, broken stone, rows of open wooden boxes in a shaft of light

scenes.narration: Fifty of them. Every one filled with earth.
scenes.visual: Close-up of an open wooden crate filled with dark soil

scenes.narration: In the last box lay the Count, looking years younger.
scenes.visual: Jonathan staring down in horror into an open box in the crypt

scenes.narration: Jonathan grabs a shovel and strikes.
scenes.visual: Jonathan raising a shovel over the open box in the dark crypt

scenes.narration: The Count's head turns. His dead eyes stare straight at him.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of the Count's staring red eyes

scenes.narration: By morning, the boxes are nailed shut and loaded onto wagons.
scenes.visual: Workmen loading large wooden crates onto horse wagons in a castle courtyard

scenes.narration: Their destination: London, the biggest city on Earth.
scenes.visual: Crates on a cart heading down a winding mountain road toward a distant sea

scenes.narration: And Jonathan is left behind with the three women. In Part 5, the Count reaches England.
scenes.visual: Jonathan at a window as three pale figures appear in the dark corridor behind him

episodes.title: She Was Next
episodes.description: Lucy has three proposals, a perfect summer, and no idea who is coming for her.

scenes.narration: Lucy Westenra had no idea she was about to become his next victim.
scenes.visual: Lucy laughing on a sunny clifftop above a harbour town with a ruined abbey

scenes.narration: She was spending the summer in Whitby with her best friend, Mina.
scenes.visual: Two young women walking arm in arm on a clifftop above the sea

scenes.narration: Mina was engaged to Jonathan, and still waiting for a letter that never came.
scenes.visual: Mina writing a letter at a window, worried

scenes.narration: Lucy had just received three marriage proposals in a single day.
scenes.visual: Lucy holding three letters fanned out in her hand, smiling

scenes.narration: A doctor, a Texan adventurer, and Arthur Holmwood.
scenes.visual: Three men in Victorian clothes standing side by side in a drawing room

scenes.narration: She chose Arthur.
scenes.visual: Arthur kneeling before Lucy in a sunlit garden

scenes.narration: But at night, Lucy had started walking in her sleep.
scenes.visual: Lucy in a white nightgown walking with closed eyes down a dark hallway

scenes.narration: Mina began locking their door and hiding the key.
scenes.visual: Mina turning a key in a bedroom door, candle in her hand

scenes.narration: Then a storm rolled in from the sea.
scenes.visual: Huge waves crashing against cliffs, lightning over a black sea

scenes.narration: And with it, a ship. In Part 6, you'll see what was on board.
scenes.visual: A sailing ship tossed by a storm, heading toward the harbour
